provenance.name: ASSISTments 2015 skill builder
provenance.licence: ASSISTments research data, free for research use with citation per the ASSISTments terms. The official Google-Sites/Drive download is blocked from this build environment, so the widely used DKVMN preprocessed copy is used; that mirror repository has no licence file.
provenance.citation: Heffernan, N. T., & Heffernan, C. L. (2014). The ASSISTments ecosystem. International Journal of Artificial Intelligence in Education, 24(4), 470-497. Mirror: Zhang, J., Shi, X., King, I., & Yeung, D.-Y. (2017). Dynamic Key-Value Memory Networks for Knowledge Tracing. WWW.
notes: Mirror format: three lines per student (length, skill ids, answers), 100 skills. The mirror's train and test files are concatenated and re-split by student with this lab's seed.
Original student ids and log ids are not in the mirror: students are numbered in file order, and no time features are available.

metrics.protocol: next-step prediction on held-out test students; every interaction except each student's first; identical rows for both models

heatmap.quantity: P(correct on the next attempt) after the student's full held-out sequence
